name: lkep_face_ref
structural_change: Move exact original hfd_lk_ep wrapper face registers into one independent hard clock root; preserve existing three relay edges each direction and all original session/reset/status edges. Parent wrapper now wires-only at face; shared endpoint core/PHY glue is still unclosed and must split separately. Actual original-wrapper fullbus comparator and valid-flit RTL mutant; no timing/gate relaxation. Requested outline is pin-limited, not approved die slot. Actual predecessor GRT failed twice RSZ-0074 on inout f_lk[9]. Split the hard leaf mixed-direction f_lk bus into 571 explicit inputs and 549 explicit outputs; parent retains the same external inout pin contract and exact behavior. No physical leaf tristate/inout ports remain.

job.purpose: New endpoint face hard leaf preserving existing wrapper latency; parent actual shared glue, PHY path, assigned pins, compensated clocks and full endpoint rate remain required. Face-only exact original-wrapper comparator is not full endpoint qualification.
